Names from the Q3 counterpart (slide, step up, trace down, event on step). NaN-aware != 0.0 tests are kept as written. pm_flags masks 0x20/0x80000/0x1 are unnamed bits.

functions.name: BG_ResetWeaponCount
functions.evidence: Resets the registered weapon count (global 0x08627080) to 0.

functions.name: BG_FillInWeaponItem
functions.evidence: Fills the item-table entry for weaponIndex (stride 0x2c, table 0x081850c0) from its WeaponDef: copies defs fields 0x98/0x1b4/0x1b8/0x04/0x1c0/0x1c8/0x1d0 and sets type=1 and weaponIndex. Name guessed from BG_FillInAmmoItems's neighbours.

functions.name: BG_FillInAmmoItems
functions.evidence: String "\025BG_FillInAmmoItems: weapon def for default weapon could not be found!" at 0x081553c0. For item slots 0x81..0x82 with itemType 2, looks up the weapon named by the first word of item->name and stores its index/ammo/clip; falls back to "defaultweapon_mp" (index 0 def when missing).

functions.name: BG_FillInAmmoIndex
functions.evidence: Error string "Max ammo mismatch for ... ammo" at 0x08155420. Registers def's ammo type: finds an equal ammoName (strcmp) among bg_ammoTypes or appends it; on a repeat name with a different maxAmmo it scans earlier weapon defs and raises Com_Error(1, ...) if another weapon already set that max.

functions.name: BG_FillInSharedAmmoCapIndex
functions.evidence: Error string "Shared ammo cap mismatch for ..." at 0x08155480 and debug print "%s: %s\n". Same registration scheme as BG_FillInAmmoIndex for sharedAmmoCapName/sharedAmmoCap, case-insensitive (Q_stricmp) and skipped when the cap name is empty; index defaults to -1.

functions.name: BG_FillInClipIndex
functions.evidence: Error string "Clip Size mismatch for ... clip" at 0x08155500. Registers def's clip type by clipName (strcmp) in bg_clipTypes; on a repeat name with a different clipSize it scans earlier weapons (Q_stricmp) and raises Com_Error. The first error argument is def->ammoName (not clipName), as compiled.

functions.name: BG_FillInAltWeaponIndex
functions.evidence: Error strings "could not find altWeapon '%s' for weapon '%s'", "...same weaponSlot setting as its alt weapon", "...same slotStackable setting..." (0x08155560/0x081555a0/0x08155600). Resolves the alt weapon by name (registering it if needed) into altWeaponIndex and validates weaponSlot and slotStackable.

functions.name: BG_InitWeaponRegistry
functions.evidence: Initialises the registry: slot 0 of every table is the default weapon def returned by fn_080f36d2, counts are set to 1, item types of slots 1..0x80 are cleared, then fn_080f2c1e and fn_080d712c run.

functions.name: BG_FillInWeaponIndices

functions.name: BG_RegisterWeaponDef

functions.name: BG_FillInAllWeaponIndices

functions.evidence: True when at least one of ps->heldSlot[1], heldSlot[2] is empty (0).

functions.name: BG_PlayerHasWeapon
functions.evidence: True when weaponIndex is valid and owned by ps, except that a def with field84 == 0 that is neither in a held slot nor the alt of weaponIndex is reported false.

functions.name: BG_WeaponFlagA
functions.evidence: 0 when field7c == 9, else 1 if field84 == 0, else 0.

functions.name: BG_TakeWeapon
functions.evidence: Removes weaponIndex (and its alt-weapon chain) from ps->weapons. If it occupied a held slot, the slot is cleared or refilled with another owned slotStackable weapon of the same weaponSlot not already slotted (note: the stackable/slot checks read BG_GetWeaponDef(weaponIndex), not weapon i, as compiled). Clears ps->weapon if it was the removed weapon. Returns 0 when ps does not own it, else 1.

functions.name: BG_SetHeldSlot
functions.signature: int BG_SetHeldSlot(struct playerState_s *ps, int slot, int weaponIndex);
functions.evidence: Puts an owned weapon with weaponSlot 1 or 2 into held slot 1 or 2. If the slot's previous occupant differs from the weapon and from ps->weapon, ps->weapon is cleared. Returns 1 on success, else 0.

functions.name: BG_FindWeaponSlot
functions.signature: int BG_FindWeaponSlot(struct playerState_s *ps, int weaponIndex, int followAlt);
functions.evidence: Finds which held slot (1 or 2) holds weaponIndex, following altWeaponIndex links when followAlt != 0. Returns 0 for weapons not owned or with weaponSlot outside 1..2. The walk loops until it returns to the start index (it can spin forever on a chain that does not return, as compiled).

functions.name: BG_FindFreeHeldSlot
functions.evidence: For a weapon with weaponSlot 1..2, returns the first empty held slot (1 or 2), else 0.

functions.name: BG_PickStackableSlot
functions.signature: int BG_PickStackableSlot(struct playerState_s *ps, int weaponIndex, int preferredSlot);
functions.evidence: Picks a held slot for a slotStackable weapon: the preferred slot if it is empty or its occupant is slotStackable, else slot 1 / slot 2 by the same rule. Returns 0 when slotStackable == 0 or no slot fits.

functions.name: BG_IsAltWeaponInChain
functions.evidence: True when weaponB is reachable from weaponA by following altWeaponIndex links (stops on a cycle back to A).

functions.name: BG_GetWeaponAmmoRoom
functions.evidence: Remaining capacity for the weapon's ammo: for weapons without a shared cap (sharedAmmoCapIndex < 0) it is the type max minus current ammo (field340 == 0) or clip size minus current clip. For shared caps it is the cap minus the ammo/clip counts of every owned weapon with that cap index, counting each ammo or clip type once.

functions.name: BG_InterpolateWeaponStanceValues
functions.signature: void BG_InterpolateWeaponStanceValues(struct playerState_s *ps, int weaponIndex, float *outA, float *outB);
functions.evidence: Interpolates two value pairs of the weapon def by ps->viewHeight: above 40 it blends fields 0x28c->0x290 and 0x298->0x29c over (viewHeight-40)/20; otherwise 0x290->0x294 and 0x29c->0x2a0 over (viewHeight-11)/29. Outputs go to *outA (first pair) and *outB (second pair).

functions.evidence: naming pass 2: Returns 0 for weapons whose aimDownSight (def+0x32c) is 0 and for several weaponstates; sole caller PM_UpdateWeaponFlag40 gates the ADS flag on it.

functions.name: PM_WeaponStateIsBinocularsRaiseOrHold
functions.evidence: naming pass 2: True for weaponstate 0x13/0x14 (decimal 19/20), the states entered by PM_Weapon_EnterState19 (raise binoculars, sets pm_flags 0x20000) and 20; the old name reads the hex values as if decimal.

functions.name: PM_UpdateAdsFlag
functions.evidence: naming pass 2: Recomputes pm_flags 0x40 from cmd.buttons 0x1000 plus PM_WeaponStateAllowsZoom; reports to BG_UpdateConditionValue(7); PM_ResetWeaponFlag40 emits event 0x95 (ADS toggle sound per pmove.md). IW lineage: PMF_SIGHT_AIMING.

functions.evidence: naming pass 2: Clears pm_flags 0x40 (the ADS flag set by PM_UpdateWeaponFlag40) and adds event 0x95.

functions.name: PM_UpdateWeaponPosFrac
functions.evidence: Per-frame update of ps->weaponPosFrac (0..1): moves toward 1 when the zoom condition holds (pm_flags bit 0x40 and weaponstate rules, a dvar-timed hold via ps->field_e0) and toward 0 otherwise, at the weapon def's per-ms rates field588 / field58c, clamped with fn_080f2954. A dvar/field128/field278 combination instead resets the state (PM_ResetWeaponFlag40, fraction and timer 0). Name inferred from the 0..1 fraction with separate rise/fall rates; the gameplay meaning is not established.

functions.name: PM_SetHoldingBreathFlag
functions.evidence: naming pass 2: Sets pm_flags 0x4000 only from PM_UpdateTimer5b8 when button 0x8000 is held and holdBreathTimer==0; dvars player_breath_hold_time/gasp_time govern it.

functions.name: PM_ClearHoldingBreathFlag
functions.evidence: naming pass 2: Clears pm_flags 0x4000, the flag set by PM_SetFlag4000; called by the hold-breath updater and the fire-delay path.

functions.name: PM_ApplyBreathFireDelay
functions.evidence: naming pass 2: When fully ADS with a scope-overlay weapon, adds dvar player_breath_fire_delay*1000 to holdBreathTimer (cap hold_time*1000) and clears the holding-breath flag; sole caller PM_Weapon_FireShot.

functions.name: PM_UpdateHoldBreath
functions.evidence: naming pass 2: Maintains ps->holdBreathTimer (0x5b8) and holdBreathScale (0x5b4) (netField names) using dvars player_breath_hold_time, gasp_time, gasp_scale, hold_lerp, gasp_lerp.

functions.evidence: Returns 1 for weaponstate 0,1,2,4..9; 0 for weaponstate 3, 11 and 12..16; for any other state calls fn_080ef946(ps) and returns 1.
